name: person_contact_two_mass

spec.name: person_contact_two_mass
spec.title: 人との接触: ロボットと人の体の部位を 2 つの質量とみて、体のばねで当たる力を時間で解く

checks.case: 2 kg robot at 1 m/s meets 2 kg body through 0.4 N/mm
checks.source: closed form of the undamped impact of two masses through a linear spring (energy balance 1/2 mu v^2 = 1/2 k x^2, mu = m1 m2 / (m1 + m2), F = k x = v sqrt(mu k)), worked out by hand: m1 = m2 = 2 kg, mu = 1 kg, k = 400 N/m, v = 1 m/s

closed form of the undamped impact of two masses through a linear spring (energy balance 1/2 mu v^2 = 1/2 k x^2, mu = m1 m2 / (m1 + m2), F = k x = v sqrt(mu k)), worked out by hand: m1 = m2 = 2 kg, mu = 1 kg, k = 400 N/m, v = 1 m/s

checks.case: same, contact time pi sqrt(mu / k)
checks.source: closed form of the undamped impact of two masses through a linear spring (energy balance 1/2 mu v^2 = 1/2 k x^2, mu = m1 m2 / (m1 + m2), F = k x = v sqrt(mu k)), worked out by hand: m1 = m2 = 2 kg, mu = 1 kg, k = 400 N/m, v = 1 m/s; half period pi sqrt(mu/k)

reason: C2 人との接触 (C2-speed1.2mps) を解けるツールが棚に無い。棚の crash と crash_beam は壁への正面衝突のツールで、人の体の部位を質量とばねで見ていない
